answer: Velvet is voice, minted only by work: keys under one control proof form a chain, falcon audits one finished job per chain each epoch and issues one non-transferable lotus. Head one burns 1 lotus to speak; head k burns k. n heads need n(n+1)/2 lotus, hence n(n+1)/2 serial falcon audits; new wallets join the same proof and queue, not a free lane.
